'''Kevin Elia''' (DeckTech handle '''KevOfCrofton''')<ref name="dt-22919">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919 2002 Yavin 4 regional 2nd Place- I Am Jacks Anger], DeckTech (Kevin "KevOfCrofton" Elia, 21 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22919/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22919/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009215140/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919/ Wayback Machine].</ref> finished 2nd at [[2002 Yavin 4 Regionals]] with a [[Dark]] [[You May Start Your Landing]] list (''2002 Yavin 4 regional 2nd Place- I Am Jacks Anger''). He played the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ 2021 Worlds Throwback Event], starwarsccg.org</ref>
